title: Social Character Counter
description: Check post length against every major platform's limit — characters, words, remaining space and a live limit bar.
howto: Pick the platform you are posting to.
Watch the live bar: green means fits, red means over the limit.

faqs.a: X/Twitter 280, Threads 500, Instagram caption 2200, Facebook post 63206, LinkedIn post 3000, TikTok caption 4000, YouTube title 100, YouTube description 5000, Pinterest pin 800.
Yes — characters, characters without spaces, and words are all shown live.
They reflect published platform limits as of 2026. Platforms change specs occasionally; the post composer itself is the final authority.
